result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, my top recommendation is **1Password Business**\. It offers the best overall balance of security, ease of use, shared credentials and administration.

However, the best choice depends on your team size, budget and whether you need to share passwords with colleagues, contractors or clients.

## Best password managers for small teams

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value overall)

From \$4/user/month, annual billing

- Excellent value for small businesses.
- Shared collections and team vaults.
- Admin controls, event logs and directory integration.
- Open-source software and self-hosting options on eligible plans.

Best if you want strong security without spending too much.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![1Password for Digital Nomads: Complete Security Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/k9DPlG2oS1kAhY0t1_mWUfr6qVPrSb5JIP9_lU7zt66pw8_MhH9QnISQTKX6UoTZKSVJemNfMrNMhx-5rTHwvq3YUGcLopCG__Wn0zxsoSbEbg42YLs6wO1_hm5hzP1p61GhjqvoPKdJFecQjX0MKC0SHD_tHrHovoKUe8ipelZ3tzfEXDI35ydWKKdW1H1i?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. 1Password**

(Best user experience)

Starter Pack: \$24.95/month for up to 10 users

- Very polished apps and browser extensions.
- Excellent shared vault permissions.
- Easy for non-technical employees.
- Strong security reporting and administration.

Best if simplicity and staff adoption matter more than price.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

Starter pricing from \$2/user/month, annual billing

- Strong administrative controls.
- Secure shared folders.
- Good compliance-oriented features.
- Useful for businesses with more formal IT requirements.

Best if you have stricter security or compliance requirements.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Proton Pass Plus - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ieWxaf1V1oKwR5RRYZyCUPTssuPFmf3KGImAFxDImLo918b9HrqSkmcFxYOmTtZlPSYlBfMDN2fRfrT9cxgSPcskegAU9CMbarL_OHz9CIE3qqDdr6RF19eJVNxO2Ol4ntEKr3D7ZAQzGf8y8YfFA_bGj9p5D2RwqWU6uGCUEvGwoAX0vUa7O4BZUHkNpExF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Secure password and identity sharing.
- Good option if your organisation already uses Proton services.

Best if privacy and the wider Proton ecosystem are priorities.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Pricing is indicative USD pricing from published 2026 comparisons; confirm UK pricing, VAT and plan limits before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.openideurope.eu](https://www.openideurope.eu/reviews/password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[itsecureops.com](https://itsecureops.com/guides/small-business-password-managers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to two\:

- **Bitwarden Teams** if you want the best balance of price, security and functionality.
- **1Password** if you want the easiest experience for employees and excellent access management.

Whichever you choose, make sure you configure\:

- Mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA).
- Separate vaults for different departments or projects.
- Individual employee accounts (never shared master accounts).
- Immediate access removal when someone leaves.
- Regular password security checks.
